mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the unemployment rate increase does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent market performance.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) are stagnant or declining, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and RSAFS stagnant/declining
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent market performance.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1%, or the low FEDFUNDS rate does not correlate with subsequent market performance.
